scope.description: Mapped polygons associated through existing atlas map IDs entity-yemen in the 1920 boundary snapshot. This measures the displayed mapped extent, not an official contemporary statistic or all territory claimed by the polity.

evidence.locator: https://cdn.jsdelivr.net/gh/aourednik/historical-basemaps@master/geojson/world_1920.geojson; file SHA256 fce1c97dc6a6095594cbb7eb896ccd5ce8b2d72254e73a24148c0a4ea200849f; geometry SHA256 88b26c641cd5e1425d8a5ed82faaaa5ededf139e8caa37e7b07b21d26e3e16a1; map IDs entity-yemen
evidence.note: WGS84 ellipsoidal geodesic polygon area, holes subtracted, exact duplicate/overlap union, antimeridian longitude unwrapping, three significant digits. No geometry repair, historical ownership or official statistical assertion. Raw computed area 292860.8675502708 km2; 1 source features. pyproj 3.7.2; Shapely 2.1.2. Derived from the actual boundary snapshot, not a population statistical geography.

qualifications: Derived mapped/geometric area, not an official contemporary historical area statistic.
Approximate historical polygons; three significant digits. Holes subtracted and overlapping mapped pieces counted once.
Boundary snapshot year is the geometry observation date. No continuous territorial validity is inferred between snapshots.
